arguments.content:
# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using `scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py`.

## Case Selection

You can run a subset of cases using one or more `--case` flags.

Example:
```bash
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --binary ./target/release/coder --repo . --out receipts/run-alpha-gamma --provider openai --model gpt-4o --case alpha --case gamma
```

### Behavior Details:
- **Original suite order**: Regardless of the order in which `--case` flags are passed on the command line (e.g., `--case gamma --case alpha`), the selected cases are executed in their original suite order (e.g., `alpha` then `gamma`).
- **Duplicates**: Duplicate `--case` flags (e.g., `--case gamma --case alpha --case gamma`) are automatically de-duplicated so that each named case runs once.
- **Unknown IDs**: If any unknown case ID is specified, execution fails immediately before creating output directories or running any cases.
- **No-filter default**: If `--case` is omitted entirely, all cases in the suite are run.
